subject: Resale certificate + letter of authority for subsidiary invoicing
body:
From: Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable <ap@atlasfurnishings.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Resale certificate for Atlas Warehouse / follow-up on billing name

Hi Nikhil,

Attached is our resale certificate for Atlas Warehouse Inc. — we purchase equipment through our parent company Atlas Furnishings and the certificate covers the warehouse entity for resale purposes. Our AP team is asking for a short letter that confirms Atlas Furnishings is authorized to invoice Redwood on behalf of Atlas Warehouse Inc. (they need this for our vendor system since the remit/billing entity differs).

I've attached the certificate (Atlas_Warehouse_Inc_ResaleCert_2027.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts a parent-company authority letter for your invoicing flow, or do you need the certificate reissued naming Redwood directly?

Thanks,
Kyle Hansen
Senior Finance Ops
Atlas Furnishings
Attachment: Atlas_Warehouse_Inc_ResaleCert_2027.pdf

---

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Resale certificate for Atlas Warehouse / follow-up on billing name

Hi Kyle — thanks for sending this over and sorry for the hold-up. A couple quick clarifications from our side so Finance can clear the invoice hold:

- The certificate looks legitimate, but our AR policy requires evidence that the parent (Atlas Furnishings) has explicit authority to be invoiced on behalf of Atlas Warehouse Inc. A signed letter on company letterhead or a DocuSign-backed authorization is usually sufficient.
- Please include the FEIN for Atlas Warehouse Inc. in the letter or certify that the parent is authorized to transact for that FEIN.
- We also need to confirm which states the resale coverage applies to (NY, PA, NJ, etc.) — the PDF you sent lists blanket coverage but not the full state list in machine-readable form.

If you can send a one-page letter or the DocuSign link, we can route to Finance and remove the invoice hold. Looping in Priya from Sales Ops who helps with vendor onboarding if any extra fields are required.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: AP Legal <ap-legal@atlasfurnishings.com>
To: Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:38:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Authorization letter (signed)

Forwarding the signed authority letter we prepared. This confirms that Atlas Furnishings (parent) is authorized to be invoiced and manage payments for Atlas Warehouse Inc. across the states listed in the letter. DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/abcdef123456

Attachment: Signed_Authority_Letter_AtlasCorp_DocSign.pdf

On Wed, Aug 25, 2027 at 11:10 AM Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com> wrote:
> Hi legal — attaching the resale cert and asking Redwood if this letter is sufficient to clear the invoice hold.
>
> Thanks — Kyle

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com>, accounts-payable <ap@atlasfurnishings.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Resale certificate for Atlas Warehouse / follow-up on billing name

Nikhil / Priya — I reviewed the attached Signed_Authority_Letter_AtlasCorp_DocSign.pdf and the resale cert. The letter meets our vendor authorization requirements:

- Signed and notarized by an authorized officer (signature and corporate title present).
- Explicitly references Atlas Warehouse Inc. and grants Atlas Furnishings authority to be invoiced on its behalf.
- Lists FEIN for Atlas Warehouse Inc. and states covered: NY, NJ, PA, CT.

Next steps from our side:
- I will clear the invoice hold for the outstanding invoices once AP confirms the vendor record has been updated to associate Atlas Warehouse Inc. with the parent account in our ERP (so we can apply the exemption to the correct remit).
- Please send a screenshot or confirmation from your vendor portal showing the updated vendor record/authority letter upload (helps our vendor team match records).
- If any line item is for a taxable jurisdiction not listed in the letter, we'll need a modified/resubmitted certificate for that state.

Priya — can you assist with mapping the vendor IDs in HubSpot/ERP and confirm if we need an internal vendor onboarding ticket?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (reviewed) Signed_Authority_Letter_AtlasCorp_DocSign.pdf

---

From: Kyle Hansen <kyle.h@atlasfurnishings.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, accounts-payable <ap@atlasfurnishings.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Resale certificate for Atlas Warehouse / follow-up on billing name

Hi Monica — thanks for the quick review. Our vendor portal shows the authority letter is uploaded and the parent/child linkage has been created (Vendor ID: ATLAS-4587). Attached a screenshot from the portal for your records.

We also pushed an updated certificate to include CT explicitly per your note. Please let us know once the invoice hold is released and we'll expect the next payment run to process.

Attachment: vendor_portal_screenshot-20270830.png

Best regards,
Kyle Hansen
Senior Finance Ops
Atlas Furnishings
